note: Hourly bars, the deepest intraday history the anonymous TradingView feed gives (21 months). Long-only. weight 1.0 is 100% of equity in index notional, about 0.4 MNQ per $25,000 at NQ 31,000; one MNQ is 2.5x.

strategies.name: Last-hour reversal after a red 14:00 hour
strategies.thesis: The 14:00-15:00 hour fell 0.4% or more: buy the 15:00 open, sell at the 16:00 open. The last hour tends to reverse an afternoon sell-off.

strategies.name: Last hour under VWAP
strategies.thesis: At 15:00 the index is at least 0.1% under the day's VWAP: buy the 15:00 open, sell at the 16:00 open.

strategies.name: Last hour above VWAP (the mirror; expected to lose)
strategies.thesis: Control: the same last-hour trade when the index is above VWAP. If the reversal is real this side should lose.

strategies.name: Red morning hour, hold to 15:00
strategies.thesis: A 10:00, 11:00 or 12:00 hour that fell 0.6% or more: buy the next open, hold to the 15:00 bar's close, 0.5% stop, 2% target. Strong through 2025, flat since March 2026.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and minute_of_day >= 600 and minute_of_day <= 720 and ret1 < -0.006

strategies.name: Morning stretch under VWAP
strategies.thesis: Between 10:00 and 12:00, 0.5% under the day's VWAP with RSI(7) under 30: buy, out at VWAP or 15:00.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and minute_of_day >= 600 and minute_of_day <= 720 and dist_session_vwap < -0.005 and rsi7 < 30

strategies.name: Midday z-score dip
strategies.thesis: Between 10:00 and 14:00, 2.5 standard deviations under the 20-bar mean: buy, out at the mean or 15:00.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and minute_of_day >= 600 and minute_of_day <= 840 and zscore20 < -2.5
